name: Host
description: A machine an axiomd daemon in host mode runs on: an LXD cluster member or an on-premise server

fields.name: Site
fields.description: The site or LXD cluster it belongs to

fields.name: Status
fields.description: Desired: active hosts get instances; draining moves them away; retired holds none

fields.name: Capabilities
fields.description: Reported: what the host can run (container, vm, GPU, storage pools)

fields.name: Facts
fields.description: Reported: what the daemon found on start and on change (OS, resources, versions)

fields.name: Health
fields.description: Reported: up while the daemon's heartbeat arrives, down once it stops, unknown before the first

fields.name: Last event
fields.description: Reported: the last control request's progress or outcome ({request, kind, message, at})
